description: VN 'làm/phạm lỗi' transfer: learners say 'do a mistake / do mistakes' for 'make a mistake / make mistakes'. Rule en-vietlish-collocation-make-mistake rewrites the verb do->make (preserving tense and capitalization) ONLY when a mistake/mistakes token is the bare direct-object head noun. It abstains on mistake compounds (mistake analysis/log) and on all other do-objects.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. 'do' is the correct light verb for most activities (do homework, do the dishes, do a mistake analysis). Negatives lock the already-correct 'make a mistake', two genuine do-objects, and a 'mistake analysis' compound surface.

positive.notes: Bare do + a mistake head noun -> make a mistake.
Third-person does -> makes, trailing adverb preserved.
Past did -> made; the yesterday past rule does not own 'did' so no double-fire.
Plural mistakes with no determiner -> make mistakes.

negative.notes: 'do homework' is correct: rule must not fire on a non-mistake object.
'do the dishes' is correct: rule must abstain.
'mistake analysis' compound: mistake is a modifier, not the object head -> must abstain.
Auxiliary/WH 'do' inversion: 'do' is not the lexical verb governing 'mistakes' (a base verb 'teach' follows). isQuestionLike + safe-tail must both reject it. (A4 regression lock.)
Sentence-initial auxiliary 'do' question: must abstain rather than rewrite to 'Make mistakes matter'. (A4 regression lock.)
